TEXT:
Looking back on what happened, my relationship 
with Sena might have peaked then.

In the end, the breast countdown stopped. Since 
then the timer has been stuck at 1.

In the end, the breast countdown stopped. Since 
then, there wasn't any progress made.
And right now, I'm...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
I never thought we would be joining the same 
company at the same time...

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT:
That's what I should be saying. You two knew each 
other from way back, but here I am, the new 
addition.

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
You say that, but we were together when we made that 
game, right? If we're talking unexpected, I'm the odd one 
out here. Why am I here with you guys?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Well, call it an undesirable but inseperable 
friendship...
It had been a few years after that incident.

It took us another year's attempt, but Akagi and I 
got into the same university.

Then, by chance, we met Makabe there, somehow it 
led to us making games again... We even ended up 
getting a job at the same game company.

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT:
I wished the President was here to make the team 
out of the four of us, though.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Yeah... I never thought he would still be repeating 
the same year yet again...

I heard he's known as the Game Research Club's 
Living Buddha now...

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
But hey, it's still awesome that the three of us 
secured a job here.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Yeah. Even though I still have no idea what you do 
when it comes to work.

He's not the creative type. In fact, he's the same as 
ever.

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
Yeah well, even in game companies, people are 
tested on their stamina. I'm so handsome. They'll 
surely treasure me!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Normally people don't describe themselves as "I'm 
so handsome".

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT: Well I mean, it's true... ahahaha...

Makabe was the one who made retorts back at the 
Game Research Club, but when he interjects 
nowadays, he works as a buffer.

The three of us may actually work pretty well 
together.

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
Alright! I look forward to working with everyone 
here at Bandai Namco Games!!!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Stop making a scene in front of the company, they'll 
think you're weird!

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT: I wonder if we'll get along within the company...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
We'll manage somehow, as usual... Well, let's put in 
our best effort.

As I was replying to Makabe, I was silently getting 
fired up.

I will... I must accomplish the dream I couldn't at 
the Game Research Club, right in this very 
company.
Here at Bandai Namco Games...

I'll make the RPG filled with big-breasted 
glasses-wearing girls that will go down in history!

While I steeled myself, there was a girl hidden in 
cover watching this scene unfold, someone I wasn't 
yet aware of.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Wow, a school love triangle changing into a 
three-way relationship!

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Onii-chan and Kousaka-senpai having Makabe-senpai 
wedged in the middle... I never thought they would 
all enter the same company...!

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
W-What should I do... What if Onii-chan and 
Kousaka-senpai ended up making love in the 
company, in their uniforms...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
And Makabe-senpai getting all the affection of the 
entire male staff during the welcome party...!!

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
...It looks so fun... Maybe I'll enter this BanNamu 
company too...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Okay, let's go!

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT: Okay.

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: Yeah.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Uhihihihi...
Huh? What's with that strange noise just now?
Probably just my imagination. At any rate...
Our battle starts now!!

[font_size=24]"My job can't be at Bandai Namco 
Games"[/font_size] [font_size=30]The End!![/font_size]

Please look forward to Kousaka Kyousuke-sensei's 
next work!
